answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a foundational defense where agents must cryptographically verify unique biological traits, preventing the fable of infinite digital scalability. Like a tiered terrace system, this creates a structural barrier; an attacker attempting to flood the wharf of the network faces a prohibitively high cost in acquiring verified credentials. Each fraudulent identity requires real-world identity validation, forcing the adversary to expend significant capital per malicious node.
